effect.basis: P20: native against the emulated delta
effect.criterion: effect when native Δ and emulated Δ agree within the floor (1 x dtype spacing at the consumer, supplied) and on the sign, and native Δ != 0; no effect when they agree and both are 0; within the floor but not on the sign unresolved; beyond the floor not confirmed or unresolved by where emulation and native part; P20: native Δ = exact Δ + rounding effect (emulated - exact) + residual (native - emulated)
effect.rests_on: rests on native = emulated within 0 spacings at a change of 56 spacings

exact.meaning: F(x1) - F(x0) (P09 section 1) on the native operands of the unedited run; written: x1 the value the edit wrote (read back). The verdict holds native against the written one

emulated.meaning: the native change predicted bit for bit: base and edited chains with the dtype's rounding where eager HF rounds
emulated.premise: rounding points of eager HF attention/MLP on this backend
premises: every step runs as eager HF writes it, on the dtype values of its operands, with the torch kernels of the run's device: affine maps as F.linear (bias fused), scores as matmul(q, k^T) x scaling and the value mix as matmul(p, v) at the native call's batch-1 shapes, RMSNorm in float32 (cast, then gain), RoPE with float32 cos/sin of float32 angles from the model's inv_freq buffer, softmax in float32 cast to the dtype, SiLU, gate x up, residual adds
the backend's kernels are deterministic at those shapes (the same operands give the same bits)
single pending row: every cached source is visible and the attention mask adds 0
the edit is written by the engine's own arithmetic (PortEdit.apply, CellEdit.realise) on the emulated value of the edited port or cache

exact.bound_scope: worst-case interval of the dtype's rounding through the chain; at least |exact|: it does not fix the sign
premises: RMSNorm in float32: mean of squares, rsqrt, scale, cast, gain
SiLU in float32 as g / (1 + exp(-g)), cast to the model dtype
matmul accumulates in float32 in any order (gamma_n bound)
replace/add/scale: the operand is cast to the model dtype and applied in one rounded op; mix: float64, rounded once
round to nearest, no overflow or underflow

linear.meaning: gradient of the consumer times the edit displacement; not the effect

method.emulated: the same chains with the dtype's rounding at every eager-HF rounding point (EmulatedRowModel); the base takes the stops at or before the cursor as captured
method.exact: F(x1) - F(x0): port-program identities on values at the cursor, base and edited chains recomputing the same stops (those the edit reaches) with the port at its value x0 or the edit written there (rows chained through the cache)
method.linear: forward-mode derivative of the same chain at the unedited point (P14)
